name: order_item_id
description: FK to order_items. NULL means an order-level refund (used for cancellations, refunding the full captured amount).

name: payment_id
description: FK to the captured payments.payment_id being refunded.

name: refund_amount
description: Refunded amount in USD (> 0). Item refunds cover merchandise only (no tax/shipping) and may be partial.

name: refund_status
description: completed = money returned; pending = initiated, not yet settled. Only completed refunds reduce net sales.
